text: RSL manufactures paint using flow production. Last year it produced 10 million litres of paint. RSL
has 6 managers and 80 employees working in its factory. The managers use different leadership
styles. RSL uses email and telephone calls as its methods of internal communication. The Operations
Manager wants to understand why some manufacturing businesses are relocating their operations
to other countries.
